body:
Two problems with the admin screen's user list, on a server that may have hundreds of accounts.

1. It is fetched eagerly. Web AdminPage.tsx runs load() from a useEffect on mount; Android
   AdminViewModel has init { load() }. Opening the console to flip the registration toggle pulls
   every account with it.
   Fix: the registration toggle keeps loading on open (it is one value). The user list goes behind
   an explicit control — a "Show registered users" button that fetches on demand and then shows the
   list with its count, plus a way to refresh it once shown. One admin screen, not a submenu: the
   screen is otherwise small, and a submenu costs a navigation step on both clients for no gain.
   Needs one new string pair in all nine locales on both clients (identical English, so
   crossClient.test.ts pairs them); commit 15d9088 (T-199) is the model for adding one.

2. It is sorted by creation date, not by email. accounts.py:248 ends
   "GROUP BY accounts.id ORDER BY accounts.created_at", and neither client re-sorts.
   Fix: order by email, case-insensitively, so the list reads alphabetically; lower(email) already
   has a unique index (idx_accounts_email_lower). Sort server-side so both clients agree for free.
   Update the GET /admin/users row in docs/wire-contract.md to say the order, the way other
   endpoints document theirs (see the members roster's "oldest membership first" wording).
title: The admin user list loads only when asked for, and is sorted by email
